text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hokyo~!! I can't believe it~!!
There are 6 upright tea stalks this morning!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
According to tea divination, this is proof of "Great Blessing"!
Victory at today's bargain sale is basically guaranteed!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
! ...Great Blessing.
I feel like something like this happened before...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fukukitaru! Mind if I come with you?
There's something I wanted to buy too.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is going on here!? Look at this massive traffic jam~!!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Driver
text_block_list.text:
Looks like a dump truck stalled out!
People and cars are completely backed up! We won't be moving for a while~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Guh... Stalled engine... massive traffic jam...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
F-Fukukitaru.
Maybe we should just wait calmly—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—This is nothing!!
Activate, "Great Blessing" power! Oryaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Troubled People
text_block_list.text:
—Sh-She moved a whole dump truck!?
—As expected of an umamusume! You saved us~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes indeed! Because today is "Great Blessing" after all!
I am Great Blessing Fukukitaru, brimming with Great Blessing power~!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*, *huff* *puff*.
Bargain, somen, big three dragons... (Daisangen)!
Oh, what a coincidence. You guys here for the bargain sale too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's a fierce battlefield today!
Packed tighter than sardines in a can! Unbelievable, I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What was that...!?
However, today is... "Great Blessing"!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —*Flash*!! "Fortune Great Blessing: Super Concentration"!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's coming, it's coming, I feel it!!
Just like in a race, if I read the flow... the path forward is to the right!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...
Handling trouble like this...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happy Great Blessing, thank you Shiraoki!
Moving forward brings loads of good luck!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So that's what it was all about.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thank you Shiraoki~♪ Lucky Great Blessing~♪
We managed to buy the good-luck care items safely—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Fukukitaru.
Air Groove's been looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Something about how "the fortune-telling booth application hasn't been submitted"...
It's annoying and noisy. Go sort it out already.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fugyaroome! I completely forgot~!
Awawawawa...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no no! Everything is fine!
Because today—

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru & Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—is a "Great Blessing", after all!!
—is a "Great Blessing", right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my way back after finishing work,
I spotted the two of them chatting amiably.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Man~ today turned out to be such a wonderful day!
Miracle-san, thank you so much for today—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fukukitaru.
Could you tell my fortune sometime too?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!? Wh-What did you say~!?
Miracle-san, you're interested in fortune-telling too!?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was thinking...
Divination points you in the direction of the bright star—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And then it's up to me to run toward that radiance with my own legs.
...Fufu.
